accept.ui_action: Space toggled approved=true; Arrow Down selected Accept; Enter submitted.

decline.ui_action: Left approved unchecked; Arrow Down twice selected Decline; Enter submitted.

stale.ui_action: While the old revision-1 form was open, a separate MCP SDK client accepted an intervening revision-1 update. Then Space + Arrow Down + Enter accepted the old form; Claude Code received stale_revision and applied:false.
